The dialog shows them stacked as 'Test Type' with no unique id visible. Consider deduping by label on list, or at least an admin bulk-delete button in Event Types.

Row component renders the calendar name inside a <span class='flex-1'> but Playwright reads empty text_content on that span even though the name clearly renders (visible via UI). Likely a React fragment/translation wrapper issue; cosmetic — the entry is clickable and all its action buttons (share/remove/refresh) resolve by id.

rca of the issue: The original bug 'event edits fail if user didnt create the event' was really 'edits from a later-day cell of a multi-day event 404'. Root cause: the items memo in CalendarPage.jsx exploded a multi-day event into daily copies with synthetic ids `${realId}_d{idx}`. The edit/delete handlers used `selected.id` directly, which for day-2+ copies is the fake id → backend returns 404. Fix: carry the real id as `_eventId` on every per-day copy and switch handlers (saveEdit, deleteEvent, duplicateSelected, refreshSelected, openItem's follow-up GET) to prefer `_eventId`. Verified end-to-end: editing from `cal-item-evt_fab5754e_d2` returned 'Event updated' and deleting from the same returned '1 event deleted'.
